title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Cherry Cranberry combines three distinctive Berry notes in perfect harmony. Sweet Blueberry and juicy Cherry meet the tart edge of Cranberry for a layered flavour that’s both rich and refreshing. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod pack includes a prefilled 2ml pod linked to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No mess, no refilling and no coil changes required. Simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coil heating supports balanced vapour and flavour consistency. Each pod delivers up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on usage. When flavour weakens or the reservoir is empty, replace with a new Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
